groups.defect: The wait_produce metric uses the tag key "shards" while related metrics use "shard".
groups.rationale: Both report the same inconsistent tag key on the same timer; changing that key resolves both.

groups.defect: The multiprocessing.Process type checks exclude SpawnProcess workers, skipping kill during restart and terminate during shutdown.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same incorrect restart guard and explicitly report the identical shutdown guard problem. Neither adds a defect beyond the other.
